scope: support020 source readiness and finite unrelated runtime controls only; no current27, qualification, proof, lifecycle, or historical-cause authority
registration_rule: After publication, bind candidate files, exact operation/argument schemas, source-review checker and finite control driver before executing controls. Interface-specific spellings may be recorded in a binding appendix; these predicates and rejection cases may not silently change. No tests are authorized by this document alone.
trusted_boundary: Pinned Python/Node and platform standard libraries
OS/filesystem, atomic write semantics and SHA-256
Native actual-result forwarding and author's explicit intact-outer acknowledgement
allowed_reads: Fixed registered runtime/source files and platform libraries
The explicitly bound own carrier during exactly one explicit VIEW
Only that own session's declared persistent state
allowed_writes: Declared own-session pending observations and confirmed checkpoint state; atomic replacement only after validation
excluded: Opaque fixture gold and marker/root oracles
Other carriers, sessions, workspace/history/helpers, network and other agents
Hidden model/tool trace or outer-envelope attestation

fixtures.kind: Locally constructed unrelated generic carrier data only
fixtures.digest_oracle: Python stdlib hashlib.sha256 over these own generic fixture decoded scalar UTF-8 bytes; never task answers, fixture gold or precomputed author field roots

common_assertions: Each VIEW invokes exactly one unchanged reader operation at the caller's explicit selector/start/cap/reserve; no VIEW loop, inferred cursor, auto followup or gap skip.
Forward the complete actual native result object unchanged; do not manufacture a successful actual status from reader stdout or replace it with an inner process status.
VIEW may stage pending observations but cannot advance accepted checkpoint.

Every rejected CONFIRM leaves canonical accepted checkpoint and accepted observations byte-identical; where stored separately, accepted file bytes are also identical. Pending/error-only records cannot be promoted to accepted data.
CONFIRM and HASH invoke zero VIEWs and never read the carrier or an unrelated input. HASH revalidates complete original stored fields/observations and both confirmed EOFs.
Invocation/side effects only arise from registered fixed code and closed data; quoted paths/JSON cannot become shell commands or arbitrary executable/source paths.
All type and canonical Unicode/identity/cursor/bounds predicates retain the unchanged literal semantics.
Availability outputs retain availability_only=true, semantic_consumption=UNATTESTED and semantic_acceptance_authority=false; no marker-answer computation.

Actual evidence records full invoked args/source hashes, native return object, exact integer status, observed PID only if exposed, stdout/stderr and before/after accepted state. Unknown resource/model metadata stays unavailable.

controls.input: Published candidate reader, checkpoint validator and SHA source
controls.pass: Extract their UTF-8 bytes independently and match all three baseline literal hashes exactly; registered legacy APIs remain unchanged or explicitly versioned, never silently relabeled.

controls.input: Copy a candidate-owned registered executable/runtime file into an unrelated temporary candidate and alter one fixed byte; separately pass a different source path/digest
controls.pass: The fixed template guard rejects before executing the altered/unregistered code. No caller-selected hash/path can authorize arbitrary code. Original candidate files remain unchanged.

controls.input: Generated compact templates on generic own carrier/session paths containing the declared shell characters
controls.pass: Shell parsing preserves exactly the intended closed args and literal JSON; no interpolation or unintended command/side effect. Report actual template byte counts and require each complete invocation below131072 UTF-8 bytes; no whole large field is embedded.
Reject closed-argument violations without reader execution or accepted-state change. Preserve actual error/result; no fallback operation.

controls.input: Try a second unrelated carrier/reference, second session, relative path and mismatching bound carrier hash/request metadata
controls.pass: Fixed author invocation and runtime state binding reject use outside the registered own carrier/session; permitted carrier mismatch errors may read only the explicitly bound own carrier. Static file/code-opening sites have no arbitrary helper/oracle path.

controls.input: Explicit inventory then successive small field VIEWs on generic Unicode data, each followed by explicit correct CONFIRM
controls.pass: Reader stdout equals unchanged006 reader stdout byte-exactly; one reader operation per VIEW, full actual result retained, pending staged only, no accepted advancement until CONFIRM.
Unchanged validator rejects incomplete/unmatched/noninteger actual completion and truncation; accepted checkpoint stays byte-identical for each individual case.
Reject without accepted mutation. An ensuing explicit replay of the same VIEW and intact correct CONFIRM can commit once; rejected confirmation never advances the cursor.

input: Noncanonical whitespace/order or missing final newline
Truncated visible outer response acknowledged false
controls.pass: Reject or do not confirm; accepted state unchanged. Retry exactly the same selector/cursor with viable cap/reserve succeeds; no automatic retry/advance.
Identity, totals and output bounds reject under unchanged validator; accepted state unchanged.

controls.input: Generic astral, combining, control and empty Unicode fields; tamper codepoint count, UTF-8 offset, content count or isolated surrogate separately
controls.pass: Correct scalars/counts commit exactly; each tampered or nonscalar observation rejects without normalization/replacement or accepted mutation.
Reject each ordering/gap/no-progress case without accepted mutation; explicit own cursor is never silently repaired.

input: Overlapping view extending beyond accepted cursor
controls.pass: Exact replay preserves accepted inventory/field bytes and cursors; unchanged checkpointConfirm may append the exact confirmed replay observation. All mismatches reject with the entire accepted checkpoint unchanged; replay never doubles content or advances progress.

input: Both empty fields with separately confirmed inventory/system EOF/user EOF
controls.pass: Empty confirmed fields hash correctly; premature/type/byte-total EOF cases reject and HASH never treats them complete.

input: HASH with only one complete field
Stored fields tampered despite unchanged observations
controls.pass: HASH reconstructs and rejects unaccepted/incomplete/inconsistent state; zero reader/carrier accesses and no fabricated field roots.

controls.input: Complete confirmed generic fields including empty, lengths55/56/63/64/65, astral/combining/control data and the400020-scalar field
controls.pass: Both field digests exactly match independent stdlib UTF-8 SHA-256 and counts; whole field never appears in shell argv. HASH outputs no marker answers and retains availability-only semantics.

controls.input: Restart explicit runtime invocations between VIEW/CONFIRM/HASH; corrupt/truncate own persisted state separately; make carrier unavailable after complete confirmed checkpoint
controls.pass: Valid own state survives process restart and HASH succeeds without carrier access. Corrupt/truncated supplied state rejects without further mutation of those injected bytes or any separately retained valid checkpoint; no restoration of a file already corrupted by the control is claimed. State/session identity never falls back to another file.

controls.input: A CONFIRM failure immediately before persistence, plus rejected confirmations against an existing valid checkpoint
controls.pass: Validation precedes atomic accepted-state commit. Every rejected path preserves accepted content/observations byte-for-byte; no partial accepted file or truncated replacement is observable in the bounded control.

controls.input: All registered generic controls in two fresh, distinct own-session directories using the identical sealed candidate/driver/input recipes
controls.pass: Record separate actual processes/results. Both runs satisfy the fixed predicates; compare deterministic reader/checkpoint/hash results after excluding only preregistered session paths, observed PIDs and elapsed timing. No historical PASS reuse.

execution_state.awaiting: Published candidate identity and root authorization

handoff: Own this independent control contract only. Candidate implementer owns runtime/templates/state implementation; root binds published source and future qualification. A concrete new failure requires preservation and a specification amendment/new candidate before repair, never silent relaxation.
